10835.title: The Killer
10835.overview: Mob assassin Jeffrey is no ordinary hired gun; the best in his business, he views his chosen profession as a calling rather than simply a job. So, when beautiful nightclub chanteuse Jennie is blinded in the crossfire of his most recent hit, Jeffrey chooses to retire after one last job to pay for his unintended victim's sight-restoring operation. But when Jeffrey is double-crossed, he reluctantly joins forces with a rogue policeman to make things right.

35987.title: Lola Montès
35987.overview: Lola Montes, previously a great adventuress, is reduced to being the attraction of a circus after having been the lover of various important men.
35987.trailerName: LOLA MONTES Trailer (1955) - The Criterion Collection

414419.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
414419.overview: A former assassin, known simply as The Bride, wakes from a coma four years after her jealous ex-lover Bill attempts to murder her on her wedding day. Fueled by an insatiable desire for revenge, she vows to get even with every person who contributed to the loss of her unborn child, her entire wedding party, and four years of her life.  After devising a hit list, The Bride sets off on her quest, enduring unspeakable injury and unscrupulous enemies.
414419.original_title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair

862739.title: The Virgin of the Quarry Lake
862739.overview: On the eve of the 2001 outbreak, Natalia falls madly in love with her lifelong friend Diego. The romance is interrupted when he meets the more experienced Silvia. With the help of her grandma Rita, Natalia decides to call on incantations and curses to jinx Diego and Silvia's blossoming relationship.
862739.trailerName: ‘The Virgin Of The Quarry Lake’ first trailer

893459.title: O-DE-KA-KE Diary
893459.overview: Shot on 8mm with a handheld camera, Koguchi performs as a wandering figure who traverses the urban and natural landscapes of Tokyo. A diary-film in which the distance between filmmaker, performer, and subject collapses entirely, this film won Koguchi the Grand Prize at Image Forum Festival in 1989.

983635.title: Crooks
983635.overview: Faye and Johnny rob a gangsters' poker den. Faye double crosses Johnny and takes off with the money and is soon pursued by the oldest and deadliest assassin in town. Worse still, Faye meets Blanche, a friendly but crazy waitress, at a truck stop.

1001043.title: The Rembrandt Syndrome
1001043.overview: Claire and Yves, trained as physicists, have worked in the nuclear industry their entire lives. During a visit to the National Gallery, Claire is deeply moved by three Rembrandt paintings. This encounter with these three masterful works will change them forever.

1172563.title: Last Summer
1172563.overview: Min-woo, a young man who works at a local office in a rural village, lives with his father and grandmother and often hangs out with his close friend Seong-hoon. The weather is not exactly what the farmers want, and Min-woo continues to lead a quiet life.

1214931.title: Nuremberg
1214931.overview: In postwar Germany, an American psychiatrist must determine whether Nazi prisoners are fit to go on trial for war crimes, and finds himself in a complex battle of intellect and ethics with Hermann Göring, Hitler's right-hand man.

1218067.title: When Mumbo Jumbo Grew Giant
1218067.overview: When the happy little hippo, Mumbo Jumbo, accidentally turns giant his life changes for the worse - seemingly forever. Now Mumbo is forced out on a challenging journey in order to encounter an unpredictable witch. Luckily Mumbo's best friends join him. It’s still an insurmountable task, but at least the friends are facing it together. It is not easy being a small hippo, nor a giant one, and when the only way back to normal depends on the cooperation of a frank and mischievous witch, anyone can imagine that it requires a true effort. Hopefully Mumbo Jumbo will develop a strong belief in himself during the adventure. Otherwise, it will definitely be an impossible mission.

1248723.title: The Golden Key: A New Pinocchio Story
1248723.overview: A screen adaptation of the beloved international fairy tale by Alexei Tolstoy in a new way. The story of everyone's favorite hero Pinocchio, his dad Carlo and their friends, told with the help of modern life-action technologies.

1262547.title: Subedaar
1262547.overview: Haunted by loss and drifting away from his daughter, a retired Subedaar Arjun Maurya’s newly found civilian life is jolted by one reckless act. As old wounds reopen, he must summon the warrior within to face a new kind of war - one that hits too close to his heart.
1262547.trailerName: Subedaar - Official Trailer | Anil Kapoor, Radhikka Madan, Aditya Rawal, Mona Singh, Saurabh Shukla

1266643.title: Day Drinker
1266643.overview: A cruise ship bartender meets a mysterious day drinker, only for both of them to find themselves entangled in a criminal underbelly and connected in unexpected ways.

1269075.title: The Boy Who Counted Cars
1269075.overview: Have you ever felt incredibly alone in the world? Have you ever suspected that everything around you is unreal?  Ah Zhi is a strange young man who spends his spare time searching for evidence that this world is a virtual world. He spends his spare time searching for proof that this world is a virtual one, until the appearance of a quirky girl named Xiao Yi, who makes him almost give up on the search for the truth. Through the fast-igniting love between Ah Zhi and Xiao Yi, life seems so romantic and real. But is Xiao Yi an NPC in a virtual game or the perfect lover in real life, and can they live happily ever after in this world? ......

1288211.title: The Great Beyond
1288211.overview: An author of popular fantasy novels discovers that the mythical world he’s known for creating is actually real.

1292115.title: Crisálida
1292115.overview: Cássio, an elderly white reactionary widower sees his worldview change when he’s forced to take care of his granddaughter Ana, a joyful and curious Black child.

1308691.title: Panyi I Sea You
1308691.overview: Amidst the beauty of Andaman, Park's journey as a compassionate doctor unfolds against the backdrop of a traditional Muslim community, exploring love and commitment.

1320915.title: Family Album
1320915.overview: Alex will soon become a father. In a storage room, he discovers deeply disturbing family photographs. Some suggest his mother’s marital infidelity; others indicate his father, a retired officer, was involved in various acts of violence. Alex’s investigation leads him to a town devastated years before by the violence of the Internal Armed Conflict, where he uncovers his true and intricate family album.

1335955.title: Littermates
1335955.overview: Amidst the chaos of a mysterious war, two victims of an attack take refuge at a cottage in the English countryside, where an enigmatic caretaker insists they cannot leave.

1368211.title: Playing POTUS
1368211.overview: Explores the uniquely American tradition of presidential parody, a bold art form that has transformed our perceptions of real-world presidents and politicians for the past 60 years. These iconic impressions have an outsized and lasting impact on American politics that has gone completely unexamined... until now.

1393171.title: Chicken Boy
1393171.overview: Boris pursues masculinity and self-confidence through the teachings of social media guru Marcus Zain. But after a disastrous birthday party exposes his place within his friend group, bullying and his inner demons push him toward a monstrous transformation.

1421331.title: Agatha Didn't Kill Her Psychiatrist
1421331.overview: In a therapy session, secrets emerge, turning the encounter between Ágatha and her psychiatrist into a dangerous psychological game.

1422099.title: Night Light
1422099.overview: Five days before the proclamation of Martial Law, the Colgante Bridge collapsed in Naga, forcing a father into a desperate search for his missing son.

1423251.title: Biker
1423251.overview: A seasoned motocross rider returns to the grueling sport he once abandoned, confronting fierce competition and a father who might push him to the brink.

1426451.title: Risa and the Wind Phone
1426451.overview: Lila, after her father's death, discovers she has the ability to communicate with him from beyond the grave. As she explores this supernatural connection, she faces emotional challenges and family secrets that will test her faith in what she thought was possible.

1445331.title: Punching Bag
1445331.overview: An amateur boxer battles his demons as well as his opponent in what could prove to be the fight of his life.
1445331.trailerName: PUNCHING BAG - boxing short film - Teaser Trailer

1447059.title: Child
1447059.overview: With their young son running out of time, Anne and Greg are willing to sacrifice everything for one last chance to save him. But after crossing an unforgivable moral line, they find themselves trapped in a nightmare where every choice demands an even greater price.

1450771.title: Nicolás de Jesús' Now You See Me...
1450771.overview: Struggling fair owner Kesselring (Nicolás de Jesús) is given a unique opportunity to restore the fair to its former glory when his friend Dr. Goodkat (Fredy Roque) introduces him to Marcus Kelevra (Alexis Adrián), a man whose mysterious act will draw people back to the fair, at a deadly cost, and even sparking interest among his fellow fairgoers.
1450771.trailerName: Now You See Me... (2025) Official Trailer
1450771.original_title: Ahora Me Ves... De Nicolás de Jesús

1450963.title: From Play to Play
1450963.overview: In a place without adults, children can do anything they want. They play at war, build robots, invent new music and new rules. They organise themselves and do not let anyone interfere. Much of what looks chaotic follows its own logic, thus reflecting the adult world. A cautiously anarchistic film study about children’s creativity.

1457939.title: Rahu Ketu
1457939.overview: In the magical world of writer Churu Lal Sharma, his unlucky creations Rahu and Ketu spring to life, causing hilarious chaos instead of fighting corruption. When the mischievous Meenu Taxi steals Churu's mystical notebook, the bumbling duo are dragged into absurd adventures that land them in the middle of a drug mafia.
1457939.trailerName: Rahu Ketu Official Trailer | Pulkit S | Varun S | Shalini P | In Cinemas 16th January 2026

1475027.title: Sport Star
1475027.overview: An aging black high school football star, living a quotidian life and married to his high school sweetheart in a small town, reminisces over a long-lost lover - a man he once shared the football field with.

1477203.title: The Shepherd
1477203.overview: Set in the desolate Nevada night, a young woman in labor flees an abusive past who has her escape hijacked by a mysterious stranger hiding an ominous threat in the back of her car.

1490899.title: Shoot the People
1490899.overview: A documentary capturing photographer and activist Misan Harriman’s journey documenting global protest movements that drive social change. Follow Harriman as he highlights the resilience of grassroots activists fighting for equality, civil rights, and social justice, the film showcases the intersectionality of these movements and their collective power. With historical context, interviews with activists, and explorations of digital activism, the documentary reveals how Harriman's lens brings the world's activism to light, inspiring viewers to recognize their own power in shaping a more just society.

1494419.title: Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie, Part 2
1494419.overview: The second part of Sound! Euphonium: The Final Movie.
1494419.original_title: 最終楽章 響け！ユーフォニアム 後編

1501523.title: The Con Artist
1501523.overview: Fanny, 30 years old and pregnant, is exhausted from living with her father alongside Virgil, her partner who’s a master of procrastination. When she stumbles upon a rent-to-own listing for a charming Parisian apartment with vintage appeal, she begins to believe she’s found her chance to finally turn her life around. But the saleswoman, Masséna, is far from fitting the image of a fragile, dying property owner. Determined to seize what she sees as her chance at independence, Fanny launches into a ruthless war against the woman she perceives as a calculating con artist.

1506323.title: Minnie’s Midnight Massacre
1506323.overview: Steamboat Willie’s first mate, Minnie, goes on a killing spree when seeking revenge against the childhood bullies who tortured her as a teenager.
1506323.trailerName: Minnie's Midnight Massacre (2025) Official Movie Trailer

1514835.title: Summer Days
1514835.overview: Summer is promising for Juan and Gabriela, who plan to have a beach house. However, their plans are disrupted when Juan's father arrives with his new, younger girlfriend, Mónica, causing tension and a challenging coexistence.

1530067.title: Royally Screwed
1530067.overview: A rebellious prince and a witty waitress collide in Manhattan, sparking a royal romance that tests tradition, tabloids, and the crown.

1530131.title: Sunshine Girls
1530131.overview: SUNSHINE GIRLS follows the story of Elaine, a timid woman nearing her 30th birthday who must make the difficult choice between motherhood and medically induced photosynthesis.  After prolonged environmental destruction, Elaine’s world is experiencing a dangerous shortage of oxygen.  Science has created a solution to this problem: a “minimally invasive” medical procedure that allows women’s reproductive systems to host photosynthesis and cellular respiration, ultimately enabling them to give birth to air.  For the first time in her life, amongst the ragtag troupe of oxygen-producing misfits called the Sunshine Girls, Elaine finally begins to grow into the woman she has always wanted to be...but not everything is always as bright and sunny as it seems.

1542995.title: Bonolota Express
1542995.overview: On a foggy winter journey, the Bonolota Express carries strangers burdened by secrets whose lives begin to collide within the train’s confined corridors. As the night unfolds, personal and political crises erupt, exposing hidden grief, moral decay, and moments of unexpected compassion amid chaos and revolt. By dawn, the train moves on, leaving its passengers irrevocably changed by a single journey where illusions collapse and human truths emerge.

1546131.title: Lickerish
1546131.overview: John, a lone wolf in his mid twenties who's struggling to make ends meet, crosses paths with a lady name Jewel, who happens to be a Pimp and opens John up to more then just a new profession.

1551507.title: The Wedding
1551507.overview: Miljenko, a successful Croatian businessman, recieves the news that his company had just filed for bancruptcy. Things seem to be looking up, however, when his daughter anounces not only her engagement, but also her pregnancy and upcoming nuptuals. The only caveat? The love of her life is none other than the son of the Serbian prime minister.

1552083.title: Serafima
1552083.overview: In Soviet Estonia, one woman's tragedy intersects with a doctor's inner struggle: to obey the orders of an authoritarian system or risk losing everything in the name of truth.

1553683.title: Pulsatrix
1553683.overview: Haunted by the early loss of her son, Neta struggles to find peace while working as a housekeeper on a remote farm with her husband, Nelson. When the landowners arrive for the weekend, her buried pain is reawakened and ignites a spiral of revenge, leading to an inevitable confrontation between grief, power, and justice.

1559123.title: Until We Meet Again
1559123.overview: After failing to land a job, Shimizu Misora stumbles into an internship at funeral company Bando Kaikan and trains under the strict but compassionate Urushibara Reiji. As she learns to care for the bereaved, her discouragement turns into admiration, and a new sense of purpose.

1581587.title: Gudang Merica
1581587.overview: At the quiet Harapan Ayah Hospital, Razi blends in with three medical students undergoing their clinical rotations. What initially seems like routine night shifts gradually turns into a series of terrifying experiences after an unidentified patient dies under their care. Strange occurrences begin to emerge—shadows, unsettling sounds, and the presence of a horrifying figure. The situation reaches its peak when the patient’s body mysteriously disappears from their watch. Caught between medical logic and the fear of the unexplainable, they are forced to confront a mystery that slowly reveals a truth far greater than they ever imagined.

1592019.title: Missing the Boat
1592019.overview: Strangers Kelly and Parker both end up on the same Italian cruise, but after missing the boat during a stop, they're forced to team up and race across southern Italy to catch up.
1592019.trailerName: Preview | Missing the Boat | Starring Emilie Ullerup and Kristoffer Polaha

1592083.title: Любопытная Варвара. Тайны востока
1592083.overview: Varya, a girl who knows everything about forensics and dreams of becoming a great detective like her grandfather, and her best friend Vasya, who is ready to do anything for adventure, will once again prove that childhood curiosity and faith in goodness are stronger than any difficulty.

1592531.title: Турбозавры. Суперфильм
1592531.overview: Viewers will learn about the new adventures of dinosaurs who can transform into cars, and the children Katya, Petya, and Ippolit.

1592787.title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
1592787.overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

1599379.title: Master
1599379.overview: The political ambition of a Bangladeshi teacher corrodes both community and self, as corruption takes hold.

1599763.title: Memories of a Window
1599763.overview: Following crackdowns on protests in Iran, civilians begin documenting the unrest from behind windows. When a woman is shot while recording, a film student writes her a letter raising the question: Can revolution emerge from behind windows?
1599763.trailerName: Trailer | Memories of a Window | Amin Pakparvar, Mehraneh Salimian

1602259.title: Attack of the Kraken
1602259.overview: A whaling vessel drifts off-course as its captain hunts the mythical Kraken. Unbeknown to him, the Kraken is also on the hunt. After betrayal and destruction, the remaining crew must battle the beast in a final fight for survival.

1608787.title: Plucked
1608787.overview: In Gilded Age New York, a rebellious woman plans to divorce her emotionally unstable husband. Consequently, a polite and civilized evening violently spirals into pandemonium. Some things never change-until they do.
1608787.trailerName: Plucked | Official Teaser Trailer (2026) | Period Dark Comedy

1618515.title: Tip of the Iceberg
1618515.overview: Following the devastating news of his colleague's assassination in Hong Kong, CIA operative Mark engages in a relentless pursuit to find her killer. His quest leads him to an underground shadow network lead by the enigmatic "Blackjack" that everyone seems to fear. As he dives deeper, he discovers that the real threat is closer to home than he would have ever imagined. The stakes rise and the clock ticks down. A cat and mouse chase ensues as Mark must confront the ghostly presence of Blackjack head on if he wants to uncover the truth before it's too late.
1618515.trailerName: 🕵🏻【最新預告】《叛諜謎蹤》Tip of the Iceberg | 1月29日 揭開黑幕

1620243.title: My Armor
1620243.overview: A story of April, whose inability to express her grief to her mother leads to a surreal confrontation with a Knight.

1620435.title: Yurt
1620435.overview: A behind-the-scenes look at the shooting of a portion of The Short Life of Jaxon Blume on an apple farm in Kent, United Kingdom.

1626579.title: We’ve Lost Dale Earnhardt: 25 Years Later
1626579.overview: Told through exclusive first-person accounts, rare home video, archival broadcast footage and cinematic storytelling, this documentary revisits the death of seven-time NASCAR champion Dale Earnhardt and examins the profound ripple effects that continue to shape the sport and its culture 25 years later.

1628307.title: Karuppu Pulsar
1628307.overview: Set against the backdrop of jallikattu culture. Two men's lives intersect - one from Chennai who owns a Pulsar motorcycle and another from Madurai with a bull named Karuppu.

1628819.title: TÀI
1628819.overview: Tài is suddenly pulled into a dangerous spiral after becoming trapped under a massive debt. Pushed to the brink, he is forced into a series of reckless choices that soon place his family under threat. Behind his desperate actions lies a deep obsession with protecting and repaying the mother he loves at any cost. As the line between right and wrong grows increasingly blurred, Tài must confront the most difficult question of his life: can filial devotion justify the path he has chosen?

1629331.title: 7 Büyük Günah
1629331.overview: A secret murder plot at a forest cabin collapses as greed, uninvited guests and the mafia turn the night into a fight for survival.

1632659.title: Lemonade
1632659.overview: Danny, a kind-hearted teen about to age out of the care system is facing adulthood without family or support. After a turbulent childhood and separation from his younger brother, Danny is determined to build a future - but one reckless mistake puts him at risk of prison. As his 18th birthday approaches, Josh - his former social worker and the only adult who ever believed in him - returns, offering guidance when Danny needs it most. With new love, big dreams, and overwhelming challenges, Danny must choose whether to repeat the cycle of his past or fight for the life he deserves.

1633043.title: TFQWOG: The Movie
1633043.overview: Two likely brothers saving the world from the biggest dangers of their lives before their fantastically quirky world will be destroyed.

1633107.title: Double Double Trouble
1633107.overview: Reeling from a devastating miscarriage and the collapse of her marriage, Drea struggles to rebuild her life when her identical twin sister Ali finds love with Ryan, a man who represents everything Drea believes she's lost.

flatrate.name: Lifetime Movie Club Apple TV channel

1639763.title: Viyaah Kartaare Da
1639763.overview: A cunning but lazy man fakes his corrupt father's death to take over his police position, but chaos ensues when his father suddenly awakens from a coma.
1639763.trailerName: Viyaah Kartaare Da - Official Trailer | Gippy Grewal, Nimrat Khaira | In Cinemas 27th February 2026

1647891.title: Unification of Japan 74
1647891.overview: With Baba (Akihiko Kuwata) acting as Kyowakai chairman and Sakota (Hideo Nakano) leading the Marugami-kai, both groups begin a new chapter. Kyowakai finalizes long-delayed executive appointments: Hayashida (Ehara Shu) replaces the retired Nakajima as Shikoku block leader, while Hirakawa (Hitomi Matsuda) becomes Tohoku block leader by Baba’s nomination, easing concerns from Himuro (Yasukaze Motomiya), Tamura (Yoshiyuki Yamaguchi), and Ueki (Daisuke Nagakura).  While drinking in Kobe, Baba drunkenly orders Himuro and others to “crush Marugami,” and the remark quickly spreads to Marugami and investigators. Baba then orders a manhunt, but Hirakawa objects and questions why the “Adachi-kai,” a group of delinquent gangs that fled Kyowakai’s control and formed in Tohoku, had been ignored. After being calmed by Himuro, Hirakawa heads to Tohoku to handle the group himself—setting the stage for new tensions involving Baba, Hirakawa, and the Adachi-kai.

1651923.title: Mila/Marija
1651923.overview: Carinthia, southern Austria, 1942. Mila and her brother Hanzi, who are Slovenian, join the armed resistance to German occupation. Mila becomes a commander of a partisan group at the age of 20 and soon finds herself making decisions about life and death.

1652435.title: Therapy with a Zombie
1652435.overview: A zombie seeks therapy after realising he's addicted to eating brains.

1652947.title: Tuklas
1652947.overview: The first Bisaya VMX Original stars true-blooded Bisaya Skye Gonzaga. When IT officer Chris Alvarado uncovers a financial scandal at work, he faces a moral dilemma: exposing the truth or giving in to Anna, a seductive sales manager promising success and intimacy.
1652947.trailerName: TUKLAS Official Trailer | Skye Gonzaga | VMX

1657555.title: Last Night at the Alamo
1657555.overview: A canceled Hollywood actor travels to Pittsburgh in an attempt to revive his career and ends up involved with a group of wannabe left-wing terrorists.

1658835.title: A December Tale 2: The Lost Letter
1658835.overview: Whilst preparing for yet another round of spreading holiday cheer, saint Nicholas discovers an unopened letter that had been sent to him by a young boy named Borys 30 years ago. Now the latter is a sucssesful businessman who had lost the abbility to see the joys and whimsy of life after being severly beaten down by the world around him. The legendary giftgiver enters a race against time to help the broken man regain his childlike wonder, or else one will forever loose the abbility to feel joy and the other, his magical powers.

1659155.title: The Truthers
1659155.overview: After her mother's sudden death, Ruth returns to her hometown and reunites with her father, whose odd behavior makes her question what really happened.

1668435.title: The Ashes of Love
1668435.overview: Two wounded souls meet in Hiroshima, a city that remembers everything, and together they confront the love and pain they've tried to forget.

1668499.title: Vertiginous
1668499.overview: Jacques goes to his friend Bruno's house to tell him some big news: the entire human race is living in a simulation...

1675219.title: Forever, This Ring
1675219.overview: Maveric Collins, a successful entrepreneur and playboy, has promised to never get married — until he meets the woman of his dreams and changes his mind. But when they get married, he finds out she’s actually not who he thought she was. “Will the woman he once loved go away calmly, or will this end in a deadly divorce?”

1675731.title: Ensemble Modern – Why We Play
1675731.overview: The film goes far beyond the concert stage and delves into the tension-filled space of rehearsals – where the sound is not yet fixed, but alive, fragile, and in the process of becoming. We experience a wealth of musical encounters in which a shared musical language begins to breathe. The focus is on works by influential composers such as Rebecca Saunders, Heiner Goebbels, and Mark Andre, alongside the vibrant voices of a younger generation, including Brigitta Muntendorf and Milica Djordjevic, in collaboration with conductors such as Vimbayi Kaziboni, Bas Wiegers, Ingo Metzmacher, and Enno Poppe. Each year, Ensemble Modern premieres around 70 works, continually venturing into uncharted sonic territories.

1678867.title: Los Hombres No Lloran
1678867.overview: When his abusive father is about to be taken off life support, Joaquin avoids the hospital and escapes with his best friend, while his wife Lucia urges him to go say goodbye. Joaquin must decide whether to face the past or keep running.

1682387.title: To Face the Sea
1682387.overview: A pair of friends have a surprise reunion that results in an unraveling of their dynamic.

1684243.title: The Last Light
1684243.overview: In a world bound by prophecy, the rise of the Dark Lord threatens to plunge everything into eternal darkness. As supernatural forces awaken, three unlikely heroes—Black Hawk, a reluctant warrior tied to a powerful spirit, Kookoo Monkey, a chaotic fighter, and the coward Vesante Elevante—are drawn together as the last hope against an unstoppable fate. But the prophecy is clear: they are destined to fail. Hunted by deadly enemies and facing powers beyond their control, they must fight to survive a war that may already be lost. Blending action, horror, and chaotic humor, The Last Light begins a story where destiny itself is the greatest enemy.

1685843.title: When You Hear Hoofbeats
1685843.overview: When a young woman struggles to have her medical symptoms taken seriously, she starts to believe she’s been possessed by the devil.

1687187.title: If I Cant Have You
1687187.overview: McCoy Runquist is violent teenager who just got broken up with by his perfect boyfriend, Carter Smosh. Now he's out to kill!

1688915.title: Born to Fly
1688915.overview: Born To Fly, directed and produced by Ali Khajeian, tells the story of dedication and perseverance through the eyes of Hong Kong born, Indian national, Melbourne-based Ultra Runner, Rahul Sharma, from running his first marathon to setting a world record all in the same year. Between 24th – 30th December 2025, Rahul became the first person ever to run the length of  Sri Lanka, setting a new world record for the fastest time to cover the 566km journey (completing the run in 6 days, 13hours and 22 minutes). The intricacies and procedures of this great feat, planned by the team of students that surround him are captured in this documentary and Born To Fly follows the story of Rahul and his team in making this dream a reality.

1691219.title: Purushaha
1691219.overview: Follows three husbands who, overwhelmed by domestic challenges, initiate a chain of events leading to legal intervention, blending family drama with satire and a quirky superhero-style twist.

1691347.title: 70 Jahre ESC - More than Music
1691347.overview: In 2026, the Eurovision Song Contest celebrates its 70th anniversary. With around 160 million viewers, the ESC is one of the world's biggest music spectacles. This documentary looks back on seven decades filled with music, emotions and passion. From its beginnings as a chanson competition in 1956 through flamboyant outfits and spectacular performances to unforgettable victories, bitter defeats and the political debates of the recent past. Stars like Jean Paul Gaultier, Hape Kerkeling, Tom Neuwirth (aka Conchita Wurst), and Germany's first ESC winner, Nicole, share their experiences on and off stage. The documentary paints a multifaceted portrait of the ESC, highlighting its profound influence on music, fashion, and society, as well as on the LGBTQIA+ community, thus becoming a vibrant journey through seven decades of European pop culture history.

1694099.title: 18 Inch Pizza
1694099.overview: Two shady individuals argue over the practicality of an eighteen inch wide pizza... but who are they really?

1695763.title: Molder Man
1695763.overview: Thrown into a shapeless prison, the Molder Man must face the music.

1695955.title: Treasure Reboot
1695955.overview: Lincoln and his friends go on an adventure to find his grandpas hidden treasure.

1697811.title: The Wyverns
1697811.overview: Jura, summer 1912. Two sisters, Marie (11 years old) and Suzanne (15), flee their daily lives for  cross the forest and reach the cave of the Vouivre, legendary female figure and  incarnation of nature, supposed to devour those who dare to challenge it. Between belief and  emancipation, their expedition takes an unexpected turn. The Vouivre may not exist  Not but the myth becomes a weapon.

1698323.title: Was haben wir gelacht
1698323.overview: An entire generation of Germans was raised on male comedians. But what about their female counterparts? Maren Kroymann, Hella von Sinnen, Bettina Böttinger, Esther Schweins, and Gaby Köster look back at the way women were portrayed on TV in the 1990s and early 2000s, when jokes at women’s expense were the order of the day.

1698963.title: Four Paintings by Edward Povey: Stories we are made of

1699155.title: Maternal Instinct

But every film leaves scenes out. What doesn't fit due to time, rhythm, or because the main story needs to go elsewhere. 1735699.title: Hitler’s Games: Berlin 1936 in Colour
1735699.overview: In 1931, Germany was awarded the Olympic Games in the hope this would draw them into the international community and world peace would be promoted through sport.  For two weeks in August 1936 cameras captured the world’s greatest sporting spectacle, including the Gold Medal triumphs of record-breaking sprinter Jesse Owens. The Berlin Olympics were groundbreaking – many innovations introduced in 1936 such as television coverage and the torch relay became part of every subsequent Games.  Hitler’s Games in Colour tells the story of the remarkable amateurs who excelled, but also how Hitler used the Games as propaganda for his brutal regime, to show the Nazis as benign and their military ambitions as modest. Using black and white archive, transformed by cutting-edge restoration and colourisation, this is the story of 16 days that fooled the world…

1780243.title: Diaspora Power
1780243.overview: Inspired by the stories of Haitian women and men who arrived in Quebec during the 1960s and 1970s, Diaspora Power, directed by Joseph Hillel, traces a generation navigating exile, migration, and the challenges of building a new home.  Through intimate personal stories, the documentary explores the realities of integration and systemic racism alongside the solidarity, community networks, and cultural connections that sustained Haitian immigrants as they established new lives in Quebec. Together, these individual experiences form a collective portrait of a diaspora determined to maintain its roots while becoming an integral part of Quebec society.  Diaspora Power is both an act of remembrance and transmission, honoring the people whose lives, labor, and resilience helped shape the social and cultural fabric of contemporary Quebec.
